claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: The photos show only an engine assembly and surrounding scrap parts; they do not show the seller's inventory, shop, or business operations.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting, idling, and revving, or a compression test result.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running assembly for parts or scrap

risks.proof: A photo of the odometer, engine number, or service records showing age and mileage.
Service book, receipts, or a documented maintenance history.

risks.risk: Missing included parts such as alternator or air conditioning compressor
risks.proof: Clear photos of all components included with the assembly, or an itemized parts list matched to images.
risks.if_unproven: as engine assembly only, without accessories

risks.proof: A mechanic's inspection report or borescope/photos showing internal condition and no crash damage.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Photos of all included accessories such as alternator and AC compressor
Service records or engine number to verify age and mileage
Mechanic inspection report or borescope images of internal condition
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a used car engine assembly, so a worst-case price is possible even without brand, model, or running condition. The seller's claim about dealing in spare parts cannot be verified from the photos.
